failure_modes: Waiting indefinitely for a release that never covers the need
Paralysis from every idea seeming subsumable
gloss: Delay building what the platform vendor is about to ship
invariants: Build value beyond what the platform will absorb
Temporary scaffolding is expected to be discarded
mechanism: Tooling built on top of a fast-moving platform is treated as a temporary solution. Sound ideas migrate into the platform itself, as sub-agent orchestration did. Before building, check whether a known release is imminent and defer work that release would make redundant.
